mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.phone, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, u.provider, u.role, u.status, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_social_accounts usa INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = usa.user_id WHERE usa.provider = #{provider} AND usa.provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_social_accounts (user_id, provider, provider_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerId})
